'''Braigin Helk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who worked as the leader of the [[Twin Suns (pirates)|Twin Suns]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], he took [[Sorin Schaff]] hostage in his own [[Schaff homestead|home]].<ref name="TORPB" />
